title: osmanthus aquifolium var. myrtifolius
intro: Osmanthus aquifolium var. myrtifolius, commonly known as Sweet Olive or Tea Olive, is a plant species within the family Oleaceae, characterized by its glossy, elliptical leaves and fragrant white flowers. The health benefits of Sweet Olive include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate stress, promote relaxation, and protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Olive include its use as an anxiolytic, sedative, and antiseptic agent, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine and aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Olive include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as borneol and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
